email.verification.subject: Verify your {APP_NAME} email
email.verification.intro: Thank you for joining us at {APP_NAME}.
email.verification.action: Click on the button below to verify your email address.
email.verification.ignore: If you didn't recently register, please ignore this email.
email.passwordReset.subject: Reset your {APP_NAME} password
email.passwordReset.action: Click on the button below to reset your password.
email.passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't ask to reset your password, please ignore this email.
email.emailChange.subject: Confirm your {APP_NAME} new email address
email.emailChange.action: Click on the button below to confirm your new email address.
email.emailChange.ignore: If you didn't ask to change your email address, please ignore this email.
email.otp.subject: OTP for {APP_NAME}
email.otp.ignore: If you didn't ask for the one-time password, you can ignore this email.
email.authAlert.subject: Login from a new location
email.authAlert.notice: We noticed a login to your {APP_NAME} account from a new location:
email.authAlert.warning: If this wasn't you, you should immediately change your {APP_NAME} account password to revoke access from all other locations.
email.authAlert.fine: If this was you, you may disregard this email.
email.passkeyReset.subject: Reset your {APP_NAME} passkey
email.passkeyReset.action: Click on the button below to register a new passkey on this device. This link will replace any previously registered passkeys for your account.
email.passkeyReset.ignore: If you didn't ask to reset your passkey, you can ignore this email.
email.invitation.subject: You are invited to join {ORG_NAME} on {APP_NAME}
email.invitation.intro: {INVITER} invited you to join {ORG_NAME} on {APP_NAME} as {ROLE}.
email.invitation.expiry: The link works once and expires on {EXPIRES}.
email.invitation.ignore: If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.
email.recoveryNotice.subject: A recovery code was issued for your {APP_NAME} account
email.recoveryNotice.intro: Staff at {ORG_NAME} issued a recovery code for your {APP_NAME} account at {TIME}. The code lets a new passkey be set up on your account.
email.recoveryNotice.fine: If you asked for this, you do not need to do anything.
sms.recovery.link: {org}: staff will read you a code. Enter it at {url} to set up your passkey.
sms.recovery.notice: {org}: staff issued a recovery code for your account at {time}. Not you? {url}
email.credentialReminder.subject: {CREDENTIAL} expires on {EXPIRES} ({ORG_NAME})
email.credentialReminder.holder: Your {CREDENTIAL} credential recorded at {ORG_NAME} expires on {EXPIRES}, in {DAYS} days or fewer.
email.credentialReminder.holderAction: Please renew it and let a safeguarding coordinator of {ORG_NAME} know, so that your access is not interrupted.
email.credentialReminder.coordinator: The {CREDENTIAL} credential of {HOLDER} at {ORG_NAME} expires on {EXPIRES}, in {DAYS} days or fewer.
email.credentialReminder.coordinatorActi: Please make sure it is renewed and recorded before then.
email.orgTransfer.subject: A transfer of your membership from {ORG_NAME} to {TARGET_ORG} is waiting for you
email.orgTransfer.intro: {STARTER} proposed moving the membership of {PERSON} from {ORG_NAME} to {TARGET_ORG}.
email.orgTransfer.guardian: You are receiving this as a guardian. A guardian decides for a minor.
email.orgTransfer.consent: Nothing changes unless it is accepted while signed in. The proposal expires on {EXPIRES}.
email.orgTransfer.fine: If you do not want this, decline it or ignore this email. The membership stays as it is.

orgs.credentials.title: My credentials
orgs.credentials.intro: Some roles at your church ask for a background check or training. This page shows what is on record for you and when each one is due to be renewed.
js.credentials.none: You are not part of an organization yet, so there is nothing to show here.
js.credentials.noTypes: This organization does not ask for any credentials at the moment.
js.credentials.unavailable: Credentials are not set up on this server.
js.credentials.loadFailed: Your credentials could not be loaded. Try again later.
js.credentials.detail.expiring: Current until {date}, which is {days} days away. Your coordinator can help you renew it when you are ready.
js.credentials.detail.expiringOne: Current until {date}, which is tomorrow. Your coordinator can help you renew it.
js.credentials.detail.expiringToday: Current until the end of today. Your coordinator can help you renew it.
js.credentials.detail.pending: Your coordinator has recorded this, and a second person still needs to confirm it. Nothing is wrong on your side.
js.credentials.detail.lapsed: This ended on {date}. That happens to everyone from time to time, and renewing is usually quick. Your coordinator can help.
js.credentials.detail.revoked: Your coordinator ended this one. They can tell you more and help you with the next step.
js.credentials.detail.missing: Nothing is recorded for you yet. If a role you would like needs this, your coordinator can help you get started.
js.credentials.contact: To renew, or if you have a question, talk to your safeguarding coordinator: {names}.
js.credentials.contactOffice: To renew, or if you have a question, please ask the church office.
js.credentials.emptyListNote: If a list or a page that you used to see is empty, it can be because a credential is waiting to be renewed. It is not a mistake on your part, and only your coordinators can see these dates besides you.

js.households.none: You are not part of a household yet. Ask the church office to add you.
js.households.unavailable: Households are not set up on this server.
js.households.loadFailed: Your household could not be loaded. Try again later.
js.households.guardianNote: You are a guardian of this household. You can change the details below.
js.households.readOnlyNote: You can see this household, but only a guardian can change it. Ask a guardian or the church office.
js.households.name: Household name
js.households.role.head: Head of household
js.households.notEncrypted: Your church has not finished turning on protection for this kind of information, so it cannot be saved yet. Please tell the church office.
js.households.denied: You are not allowed to change this.
js.households.gone: This household or person could not be found. Reload the page.
js.households.photoHelp: A JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
orgs.registers.cert.title: Register entry certificate
orgs.registers.cert.notice: Printed from a working register. Whether this page is valid as a certificate is for the church to decide.
orgs.consentPurposes.title: Consent purposes
orgs.consentPurposes.intro: What people in your organization can agree to, such as a newsletter or photos. When you change the text of a purpose, its version goes up and earlier consents show as given on an older version.
orgs.consentPurposes.empty: No purposes yet. Add the first one below.
orgs.consentPurposes.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. It cannot be changed later, and it must be unique across all organizations, so something like "yourchurch-trips" works well.
orgs.consentPurposes.textHelp: Say in plain words what the person agrees to. This exact text is kept as evidence with every consent.
orgs.consentPurposes.minAgeHelp: Below this age a guardian gives the consent. Leave empty for no minimum, or 18 for a marketing purpose.
orgs.consentPurposes.guardian: A guardian must always give this consent
orgs.consentPurposes.marketingHelp: Direct marketing can never be consented to for a minor, and the minimum age is 18 when you leave it empty.
js.consentPurposes.savedVersion: Saved. The text changed, so this is now version {version}.
js.consentPurposes.retired: The purpose is retired. It is no longer offered, and the evidence stays.
js.consentPurposes.confirmDelete: Delete the purpose "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
js.consentPurposes.hasRecords: People have already given consent to this purpose, so it cannot be deleted. Retire it instead; the evidence stays.
js.consentPurposes.noAccess: Only the owners, admins and registrars of this organization can manage its consent purposes.
js.consentPurposes.notMember: This account is not an active member of that organization.
js.consentPurposes.unavailable: Consents are not set up on this server.
js.consentPurposes.loadFailed: The purposes could not be loaded. Try again later.
orgs.registers.page.title: Registers
orgs.registers.page.intro: The permanent registers of your organization. A final entry is never edited: a mistake or a later event is written in the margin as a note. Finalizing cannot be undone and asks for your passkey.
orgs.registers.page.none: No register is set up on this server.
orgs.registers.page.annotateHelp: A note stays for good: it can be answered by another note, never changed or removed. To take back a note, add a retraction that points to it.
orgs.registers.page.reason: Reason (what you saw or who asked)
orgs.registers.page.certHelp: Print this page, or save it as a PDF from the print dialog.
js.registers.request: Put forward for a second signature
js.registers.waiting: You put this entry forward. A different registrar has to confirm it.
js.registers.confirmFinalize: Finalize this entry? It can never be edited or deleted afterwards. Corrections will be notes in the margin.
js.registers.confirmRequest: Put this entry forward? A different registrar must confirm it, and it cannot be edited after that without a new request.
js.registers.confirmConfirm: Confirm and finalize this entry? It can never be edited or deleted afterwards.
js.registers.requested: The entry is waiting for a second signer.
js.registers.stepUpFailed: The passkey check did not finish, so nothing was changed.
js.registers.loadFailed: The register could not be loaded. Try again later.
js.registers.noAccess: Only the registrars, owners and admins of this organization can open its registers.
js.registers.notMember: You are not a member of this organization.
js.registers.readOnly: You can read this register. Only a registrar can finalize entries and add notes.
js.registers.certFailed: The certificate could not be loaded.
js.registers.certNeedsFinal: Only a final entry has a certificate.
